description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by disc-0010. The agent-facing text file has an exact byte layout: H1 (first, as llms.txt v2 requires), provenance comment, blockquote, cluster sections ordered by slug, an Other section for unclustered items, one blank line between blocks and nothing else. An item with no description repeats its title; a draft item appears nowhere. Without this pin two conforming writers emit different bytes and Level 0 is unreachable.
